top_call_exchanges.topic: Blackwell B200 Cluster Ramp & Sovereign/Tier-1 Demand Durability
top_call_exchanges.question: Can you provide more granularity on the Blackwell B200 turn-up schedule for Q4 and into 1H 2027? Are enterprise customers and frontier AI labs signing multi-year commitments despite rapid chip architecture replacement cycles?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Michael Intrator (CEO): 'Demand for our specialized AI cloud continues to accelerate faster than power can be energized. Every single Blackwell cluster scheduled for delivery over the next four quarters is already fully allocated under multi-year contract take-or-pay structures. Customers recognize that our software orchestration and networking fabric deliver up to 30% lower training latency than general-purpose hyperscalers, ensuring durable high utilization.'

top_call_exchanges.question: You mentioned expecting approximately $9 billion in customer prepayments and deposits in the next three months. How does that cash inflow alter your debt issuance plans and equity dilution expectations for the $37B-$39B CapEx program?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Michael Intrator (CEO): 'Customer prepayments represent the purest form of non-dilutive financing. These are enterprise customers and sovereign entities committing multi-billion dollar capital upfront to guarantee multi-gigawatt delivery. Combined with our operating cash flow inflection to nearly $2 billion this quarter, this liquidity provides immense balance sheet flexibility without requiring opportunistic equity dilution.'

top_call_exchanges.topic: Adjusted Operating Margin Trajectory & Depreciation Headwinds
top_call_exchanges.question: You raised adjusted operating income guidance by 26% at the midpoint while operating margins reached double digits ahead of schedule. As $38B in assets hit the balance sheet, how should we think about gross margin sustainability against rising depreciation?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Michael Intrator (CEO): 'Our gross margins in Q3 remained robust at 67.7% because cluster utilization ramped immediately upon energization. Because our contracts are structured with multi-year take-or-pay minimums, depreciation is matched against contractual revenue inflows from day one. We expect operating margin expansion to continue as corporate overhead scales over a doubling revenue base.'
